dialogues.speaker: Elowen
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! Would you like to try the "Surveying and Searching" challenge again?

choices.text: Yes, I'd like to try it once more...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Yeah... It's a shame that we didn't have enough time to prepare. I only managed to make a few calibration markers.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: If I get the chance to organize another 'Surveying and Searching' challenge, I'm going all out. I'll make sure every famous knight's likeness is included in the challenges!

choices.text: I'm already looking forward to the next time...

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: "Next time"? Oh yeah. Even though we've only known each other for a few days, it feels like we've already become a team with incredible coordination!

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: If there's another opportunity for us to learn and grow together like this, I definitely won't miss it.

response.speaker: Elowen
response.text: Hmm... Next time I'll prepare more ingredients so everyone can try the real "feast on the battlefield"!
